Subject: Re: sudden p95/p99 spike after canary - please advise

Initial triage: we see a marked increase in KV cache pressure and a rise in long-tails for sequences > 1024 tokens on model-variant v2. The runtime is hitting more synchronous kernel paths for certain attention sizes which explains p95->p99 widening.

Actions taken:
- Paused the canary ramp at network layer (traffic still at 12%).
- Started a fast rollback plan to route all GuardianAI traffic to variant v1 at 09:05 PT (can do at router, 1-2m to converge).
- Spun up an isolated Dedicated hot-path pool to accept overflow if rollback causes transient queueing.

Attachments: p95-heatmap.png (heatmap showing the p95 jump across routes)

We'll monitor for 20 minutes post-rollback. If KV pressure is the root cause we have two mitigation options: strengthen prefix caching for common prompt patterns, or adjust batching window to favor per-request latency. I'll follow with logs.

-Karthik
Senior Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
